display.title: T4: Make Antimatter
display.subtitle: Build the SPS, produce your first pellet
description: The §bSupercharged Particle Accelerator (SPS)§r is the apex of the
Engineering lane: feed it polonium pellets and the colossal RF your fusion
reactor makes, and it produces §bAntimatter Pellets§r - the rarest
Build the SPS multiblock (§bSPS Casing§r, §bSPS Port§r, §bSupercharged
Coil§r) and run it until you hold your first §bAntimatter Pellet§r.
§7The SPS is the largest sustained energy draw you can build - it is the
RF-hyperscaling sink the whole tech tree was climbing toward.
